description: Connects this agent to the person's Todrawn account so the board_* tools work. If already signed in it says as whom. Otherwise it returns a link and a code: ask the person to open the link and approve the connection, then retry. Sign-in finishes by itself in the background once they approve. The Scribe video tools need no sign-in.
name: todrawn_login
title: Sign in to Todrawn
